finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical: 1082 hits, 94 files. About 180 of them must not change.**

Four frozen zones:

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/*.sql` | 37 | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 12 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract. Needs a dated version. |
| SQL text in 25 repos | 125 | Real column name. No column migration here. |

Two more spots to hold. The wire value in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) is the public key. The persisted JSON key in [services/orders/src/repo/order.js:35](services/orders/src/repo/order.js:35) lands in `payload` JSONB, so old rows and new rows would disagree.

The other ~900 are JS locals, params, and `audit` fields. Safe. Ask them to confirm `req.session.account_id` renames in lockstep across all 25 route files.
